_help: Home page reviews. stories: one customer video plus their review each; the dots switch between them. For each video, put an .mp4 in public/site-images/ and set "video" (e.g. "/site-images/review-1.mp4"), or set "youtube" to a YouTube video ID. "poster" is the image shown before playing. The sample names and quotes are placeholders: replace them with real guests. travelerPhotos: fill names, from and caption for real guest photos.

stories.name: Emily R.
stories.quote: Our guide made Paris come alive! The perfect blend of history, culture and local stories. This was the highlight of our trip.

stories.name: James T.
stories.quote: Skipping the queues at the Louvre was worth every euro, and our guide knew a story for every painting we stopped at.

stories.name: Sofia M.
stories.quote: Small group, warm guide and the best crêpes in Montmartre. We felt like locals for an afternoon.
